Battle Start!
gwah
What just happened? Where am I?
One second, I was with my party, preparing to fight, and the next, I'm...here.
I need to figure out where I am and get back to my party as soon as possible. Before something happens to them, or something happens to me.
Maybe, if I just start moving, I'll come across some sort of landmark to let me figure out where I am. Or even better, another adventurer who could point me in the right direction.
Is this some sort of castle town? I've never seen or heard of anything like this on the first floor of the dungeon. Things like this only appear at least 5 floors down, if not more.
(Rustling sound in the distance)
Wh-what was that!?
Is it a person? They might be able to help.
A Skeleton? I need to fight.
Hey, hey! Wait! What are you doing? Do you want money? I don't have much. Only what's in my bag.
Huh? Why aren't you attacking me?
W-why would I attack you? Oh Lord, you're human...
Am I supposed to try to kill it? That's what they would tell me to do, but I don't have any...dead, so I don't...just run...this level is...attack...
Um, skeleton?
Just-just take my stuff. I've gotta get back anyways.
What the heck was that?
I should probably look at what's in this bag.
OW! What are you...? Why? I haven't done anything to you!
Wh-why...
Is that skeleton's name Jerald? And it has a wife and kids? But...it's a monster.
Was that skeleton's name Jerald? And it had a wife and kids? But...it was a monster.
I need to keep moving. I doubt that monster is the only one around, even if it didn't really give me any trouble.
Hey there. Are ya lost?
ACK!
I didn't hear anyone approach.
Hello?
Down here!
Woah, a creature this big might be able to pose a threat. I should prepare to attack.
Hey, no need to get all defensive, I just wanna help ya out.
Oh wow! Are ya human? I haven't seen one of ya in... I can't even remember how long.
You can talk?
Well, duh. I'm talkin' to ya right now. The name's Mr. Rat.
So, do ya need directions, or what? Cause I know this floor like the back of my paw.
Just like that skeleton, this monster doesn't see, particularly intent on attacking me, but I need to be careful.
But even from a giant rat, if I can get directions, then I can't pass that up.
Did you say you know this floor?
Yup, like the back of my paw. Need me ta repeat everythin' else I said too?
No, no. I'm ok. I'm just wondering? What floor is this?
Oh man, that's a good question, ain’t it? I know what's on the floor, but I ain't ever left it, so I don't know what's around it.
We're pretty low down, I think. That's somethin' I heard anyway. That we're so far down that we never see humans like ya.
I'm that far down? How is that even possible? I was just with my party on the 1st floor.
No, this rat must be lying to me. If I was that far down, that skeleton from before wouldn't have been scared of me. It would've been able to kill me easily.
Monsters in the depths of the dungeon are deadly to almost any adventurer, that's why they never make it this far down.
Hey, what's got ya so stuck in yer own head? Especially while yer still standin' like yer gonna attack me.
This is what everyone always tells me. I gotta stop bein' so nice ta people cause one day it's gonna get me killed.
You're a monster, of course I'm going to kill you.
That's a bit stereotypical towards monsters. don'tcha think? I mean, we ain't humans like ya, but we ain't just one species either.
Lumpin' me in with dragons is a bit insultin' to the dragons, haha.
But yer clearly raring for a fight, and I ain't gonna sit still and letcha kill me, so let's just get on with it.
Why aren't you trying to kill me? You're a monster, aren't you?
Letter and Flowers added to inventory.
Wait! We don't need to fight.
We don't? The weapon you've had aimed at me since we started talkin' says otherwise.
I'm sorry. I was just...
I was expecting you to attack, so I was just being prepared.
Alright then, that's all I needed to hear.
Anyways, human. I gotta get goin'. But a bit of friendly advice fer ya. Try not to raise yer weapon at just anyone.
I know some guys who'll pounce the moment they think they might be in danger.
My buddy Tony's like that. Real jumpy guy. Super nice when ya get ta know him though.
Uh, ok. Bye then, Mr. Rat.
Maybe we'll meet again, so don't forget it. Oh, and take this money. It might help ya out. See ya.
Well that was interesting. Am I really on one of the lowest levels of the dungeon? If that's true, how am I supposed to get back to the surface.
I hope my party is doing ok without me. For now, I just need to keep moving. Nothing is going to happen if I just stand here.
I'm not backing down.
So, we're really doing this?
It's kill or be killed in the dungeon.
It doesn't have to be.
Woah, woah. Who's there? I just got comfortable.
What the hell? Where did that voice come from?
You just walked right into me and you haven't even apologized? Have you ever been taught manners?
Walked into you?...wait.
Oh... Hi there, sir.
That didn't sound like sorry to me, little one.
Little one?
That's what you are, aren't you?
That's not the nicest way to say it. It sounds like you're looking down on me.
But you're all the way down there, so I am looking down on you.
That's not really what I...
It doesn't matter. I'm still waiting on that apology.
Willow bites {N}, dealing critical damage.
I don't know why I'm supposed to kill you, but Charlotte is really smart, so I should listen to her.
I didn't expect her to suddenly attack. What should I do?
Wait! Willow, we don't need to fight!
It feels strange to say that to a monster, but she really didn't seem like she wanted to hurt me until she remembered she was told to.
That's true...
But I'm supposed to kill humans. That's what Charlotte said, and she's usually right about things.
If Willow gets one more hit in, I think I'm going to die.
Please Willow! I really don't want to hurt you. You don't have to do something just because Charlotte tells you to.
Don't say that! You don't even know her! If she says I'm supposed to kill humans, then I will!
From the way you talk about her, Charlotte seems really nice and smart, so it makes sense that she would say to kill humans, but that's because humans usually try to kill spiders.
Huh, but you didn't try to kill me?
Exactly. I bet what Charlotte told you was that if a human attacks you, you have to make sure that you kill them first, otherwise you won't survive.
But, if we don't fight each other at all, then we both get to survive, and isn't that way better?
Oh yeah, that makes sense! And then we get to be friends!
<size=180>AHHHHHHHH!!!</size>
<size=180>AAAAHHHHHHHH!!!</size>
Oh wait. Why am I screaming?
Why are you screaming?
Oh Lord, did I scare you? I didn't mean to. Charlotte keeps telling me I'm not scary, but maybe she's just lying.
I deeply apologize for dropping down in front of you. It was not my intention to scare you nor make you feel in danger.
That's how Charlotte says I'm supposed to apologize, right? I think so.
But I am sorry. I can make it up to you! I mean, I don't really have much.
Oh! I know. I have friendship! Yeah, that makes up for scaring you, right?
Ok, let's start over. My name is Willow. What's your name?
Wow, this spider loves to talk. Which is especially weird because up until right now, I didn't even know spiders could talk.
Hi, I'm {N}.
Nice ta meetcha!
Wait, are you human? Charlotte talked a lot about these things called humans. She said they're like skellies, but if they were wearing colorful meat suits.
I thought that was kinda weird, but you're not weird.
Ok, you're a little weird, but a lot of people say I'm weird, so it's not weird to be weird. I think.
I'm not going to be able to do anything or go anywhere if this spider keeps talking.
Hey, Willow?
What should I even say? I'm talking to a monster...but it, er, she, seems nice, if not a little annoying.
I kind of want to ask who this Charlotte is, but that would probably just spur on Willow to talk even more. Maybe I should just see if I can get information.
Could I ask--
Oh! I just remembered something! There was something else Charlotte told me about humans.
Ummmmm, what was it?
Right! We're supposed to kill them!
Wait, what?
Wouldn't it make more sense that Charlotte told you to kill humans when they attack you?
Whoever this Charlotte is, she probably understands that most humans would kill a spider the moment they see one.?
But if Charlotte knew that a human wasn't trying to hurt Willow, would she still tell Willow to kill them??
Not all humans want to kill you, so you don't have to kill all humans.
But Charlotte didn't say that! You're probably making it up. And I bet you're lying too, and you do want to kill me.
Well, I won't let you!
Willow, if you really want to kill me, then go ahead. I don't want to hurt you.
Since we just met, I don't know you very well, but I can tell you, I'd love to take you up on the offer of being your friend.
But we can't really make that work if I'm dead, can we?
Oh Lord, you're right. I'm sorry, I can't believe I attacked my friend!
I only did it because Charlotte said to, I promise. She probably didn't know that I could be friends with a human.
I don't want to kill my friend.
Willow, listen. Please. If you don't hurt me, I won't hurt you. It can be like a trade.
And then, I could talk to Charlotte. Tell her that you didn't need to kill me because I didn't attack you.
No! I can't bring you to see Charlotte. Because then she'll see I didn't listen to her.
And what if that makes her think I don't trust her. I do trust her!
And because I trust her, if she says I'm supposed to kill humans, then I am going to kill you.
I didn't ask.
Wow, that's um, kinda rude. Charlotte says I'm not supposed to talk to rude people.
Well ok then new friend! How about we start over. My name is Willow.
A monster attacking me. Finally, something that makes sense.
Owwwwwww. That hurts.
Charlotte said I'm supposed to kill you, not you kill me.
If you attack me, I will do the same in return. I don't plan on letting you kill me without fighting back.
I hope...my big sister doesn't miss me too much. I'm sorry, Charlotte...
I can't help but feel a little bit bad about that...
Let's hope I never run into this Charlotte. I'd really rather not deal with that.
Wow, she got over that quick.
My name is {N}.
Well then {N}, it has been really nice to meetcha! But I really should get going now. I gotta go find Charlotte before she starts worrying about me.
Hopefully we'll see each other again soon!
Yeah, see you later, Willow.
Well, Willow definitely has a bit of a complex about whoever this Charlotte is, but overall, she wasn't that bad to talk to.
She's kinda cute actually. In a younger sister kind of way.
But...now she's gone, and I'm right back to having no idea where I am or what I'm doing. How far is the surface? I need to get back.
What should I even say? I'm talking to a monster...I should probably just kill it...or, 'her' I guess.
Well, I guess my friends were right. It's bein' nice that killed me in the end.
Woah! You're HUGE!
I didn't see you there.
A golem?! Woah.
Ha! You're funny.
I didn't mean that literally.
I don't think you... ugh. Whatever.
I've been traveling alone since then. If you wanted to come along... If you want to spend more time with me... Then, you should join my party.
This golem was already intimidating, but now he seems pissed off. I should probably just apologize.
Looking at him now though, I'm not sure he's going to listen. But I'm also not sure I could beat him in a fight.
He's HUGE. Those arms look like they could break me in half. And those rock hard calves...
Wait, this is a monster I'm thinking about. A massive golem that is currently trying to kill me...
I can't let myself get distracted. I need to fight back. Or maybe I could talk him down.
I don't know what I'm thinking. It's just a pile of rocks.
He blocked my path. Maybe he should apologize to me.
I don't know what I'm thinking. That's just a bunch of rocks.
Hey, Rock Golem? I don't want to fight yo---
It's not nice to walk into people.
It doesn't seem like he'll listen to me right now. I guess I have to fight back. Maybe I can just wear him down.
I think he's worn down enough. I could apologize now.
Hey, uh, I'm really sorry for walking into you earlier. I should've apologized already.
Hey, Golem, I'm sorry about walking into you earlier. Maybe your pull is just too magnetizing. I couldn't help it~
I'm sorry about walking into you earlier. I didn't see you there.
Sorry 'bout earlier when I walked into you. You were kinda in my way... but I should've apologized.
Really! Well that's all I needed to hear!
Oh. and I should apologize for attacking you. That really wasn't right of me.
It's just... I had just fallen asleep when you walked into me and woke me up, and sometimes I get pretty cranky when I wake up.
It's just not usually so, uh, violent, though.
I promise, I'm not normally like that. And I'm definitely feeling better now that you knocked some sense into me.
You're actually really cute when you're not attacking me, Mr. Rock Golem.
Oh my, I never would've guessed someone as strong as yourself could also be so adorable.
You're actually quite cute like this.
That was quite the switch up, you know? You've got quite a cute side for someone so powerful.
Oh, um... Do you really think that? I mean, I think you're pretty cute too.
No one's ever said something like that to me.
I'm sorry, I should probably, um.. go. I don't want to take up any more of your time. I'm sorry for attacking you.
Wait!
I don't want him to leave! I actually might be kind of... attracted to him???
Maybe if I flirt with him, I could get him to stay and see if he's interested.
You're being too nice to me. I really don't deserve it... Especially from you.
Hey, if you're still beating yourself up about attacking me, you gotta stop it. I forgive you.
And what do you mean 'especially from you?'
I mean, well, I know we just met, and it wasn't under the best circumstances, but I can already tell how amazing you are.
You're strong, kind, attractive, and you really seem to care about me even though we barely know each other.
I don't even know your name and you're already making me blush like crazy.
Well, I could say the same about you. So, maybe we should change that. I'm {N}.
It's nice to officially meet you, {N}. I'm Rocky.
Hehe. 'Rocky.' That's a little on the nose, isn't it?
Hey! Don't make fun of me.
I'm not, I'm not. It's cute. You're cute.
Stop saying that. I think I'm gonna explode.
Maybe I should make that my goal then.
Want to come with me?
What?
I've been traveling through the dungeon. I was separated from my party and sent down to this level somehow.
Really? Oh lord, I would love that! Of course, I'll join your party!
Hey, {N}? Could I kiss you?
What? I mean, yes! Yes, please do.
I suddenly feel like I want to fight the golem for some reason. I guess it will get his attention back on me at least.
I don't want to... die yet...
That was FUN! Finally, a real challenge. I should get going, there's a whole dungeon of monsters for me to slaughter.
I'm glad that's over with. Now I have to keep going. I have an exit to find.
I should probably... um, go now. Again, I'm so sorry about attacking you.
Wait! Don't just leave! At least tell me your name before you go. I'm {N}. Maybe we'll see each other again.
Oh ok. I guess. I'm Rocky.
Well then, Rocky. This was... quite an interesting way to meet. See you later.
Yeah, see you, {N}.
You're quite the strong opponent. Especially compared to all of the other monsters I've come across since I ended up on this floor of the dungeon.
That's not something I should take for granted when it comes to surviving and killing enemies.
Wait, wait... Kill? Oh-oh no, I really hurt you, didn't I.
Well, yeah. Obviously. You're a massive golem made out of rock and you attacked me. What did you think was going to happen?
Oh, Lord. People always tell me I'm not myself when I wake up, but I- I didn't mean to. I'm so sorry.
Attacking someone isn't just something you do because you're groggy in the mornings.
I know, I know. I don't know what came over me. And I don't know what else I can do other than apologize.

strings: It doesn't matter, he attacked me

data.dialogue: Save your apologies for someone who cares. You're a monster and this is a dungeon. If I want to survive, I'll do what I must.
It doesn't matter what this golem says. He is a monster, and this is a dungeon. I need to kill it.
You fled the battle!
Little one?
Little one?
That's not the nicest way to say it. It sounds like you're looking down on me.
That's not the nicest way to say it. It sounds like you're looking down on me.
